subject: Halp with error specified K is too small. Try a value larger than any observation

messages.author: 42c52ac21fdf668a
messages.subject: Halp with error specified K is too small. Try a value larger than any observation
parts:
Hi everyone, I hope you can help me.

I tried to make abundance estimations of repeated counts of Andean condors in 84 points, in intervals of 15 minutes. I used the function pcount, but when I want to run the models I get this error: 

Error in pcount(~1 ~ 1, umf, K = 30, control = list(trace = T, REPORT = 1)) :
  specified K is too small. Try a value larger than any observation

My max observation was 20 individuals, I modified the K number with different options (50, 100, 200, 300) but I can´t fix the error.

What can I do?

Thanks for your suggestions

--
Fausto Sáenz Jiménez
Biólogo UPTC
PhD Ciencias Biológicas - Pontificia Universidad Javeriana
Investigador Fundación Neotropical

messages.author: 4f80e1927b0757cb
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Halp with error specified K is too small. Try a value larger than any observation
parts:
Take a close look at your final y-matrix:

umf@y

Are you sure that no large values ended up in this matrix?

max(umf@y, na.rm=TRUE)

Sometimes I have seen a column of covariate values accidentally get added to the y-matrix.

If umf@y looks correct (i.e., no values > 20), then there might be a bug here. I'd have to look more closely at your code/data, which you are welcome to email me off-list.

Ken
